TopicConfirmation.title: TopicConfirmation
TopicConfirmation.description: Compliance verification record representing user acknowledgment, signature, and approval status for a topic

targetGroup.description: Target audience group (ALL, ALS, Lead, ALS_AND_LEAD, CUSTOM)

userName.description: Full name of the assigned staff member
